_comment: Spec 163 - the PINNED study contract for the spec-162 calibration study (protocol cal-v2).
analyze-labels.ps1 loads this file from its own directory (never a CLI parameter): a precommitted
protocol value an operator could override is a protocol violation an operator could make validate.
promptTemplateSha256 is the SHA-256 of scripts/calibration-audit/labeling-prompt.md under the
canonicalization named by hashCanonicalization: decode the file's bytes as UTF-8, replace every
CRLF (\r\n) with LF (\n), re-encode as UTF-8, hash those bytes. The repo has core.autocrlf
checkouts, so the on-disk template is CRLF on Windows and LF on CI - the LF-normalized hash is the
one value both agree on, and every Phase-B label's protocol.promptHash must record it.
Changing the labeler or materially editing the template mid-study is a protocol-version bump
(cal-v2 -> cal-v3) that RESTARTS the affected labels - update this contract in the same change.
